purpose: Dataset-level provenance supplement for the five-subcorpus FRSB robustness aggregate.

splitPolicy.description: Each subcorpus contributes 200 calibration images and 200 evaluation images to the promoted 1000-evaluation aggregate. Calibration images set the global clean threshold; evaluation images are watermarked, attacked, and scored under common detector parameters.
splitPolicy.imageIdentityPublication: Image-level identities for the five-subcorpus robustness aggregate are retained in a private local map because source datasets retain their original terms. This public manifest publishes dataset-level source, version, citation, reuse-status, counts, and non-redistribution policy only.

subcorpora.reuseOrLicenseStatus: Public Binghamton DDE download page lists BOSSbase 1.01 as 10000 grayscale BOSS competition images; no explicit redistribution license was located in this pass.
subcorpora.identityStatus: Private identity map recovered 30/30 local records; image-level identities are not published in this manifest.
subcorpora.redistributionPolicy: Aggregate metrics and dataset-level metadata only; pixels are not redistributed; obtain pixels from upstream source under its terms.
